title: Hoggaamiyaha loo magacaabay Qaranka
intro: Waqtigii caqabadda iyo quusashada weyn ee dad, waxaa la sameeyay ballan rabbaani ah. Qofkan, oo markii hore dad badan iska indha tireen, waxaa Alle u doortay inuu hoggaamiyo qaran ka dhan ah cadow xoog leh. Sheekadoodu waxay markhaati u tahay awoodda iimaanka iyo xigmadda ka dambeysa amarka rabbaaniga ah, taasoo muujinaysa in hoggaanka dhabta ah aan had iyo jeer laga helin meelaha la filayo.
clues: Waxaa Alle ii doortay inaan noqdo hoggaamiye dadkayga markii ay raadinayeen hoggaamiye u dagaallama ujeeddadiisa.
Dadkaygu waxay markii hore su'aal ka keeneen magacaabistayda, iyagoo dareemaya in kuwa kale ay u qalmaan sababtoo ah hantidooda ama abtirsiintooda.
Calaamad muujinaysa hoggaankayga saxda ah waxay ahayd soo laabashada sanduuq barakeysan, oo ay ku jiraan waxyaabo qadiimi ah oo ka yimid nebiyadii hore, taasoo keentay xasillooni.
Waxaan ciidankayga u horseeday webi, halkaas oo aan ku tijaabiyay addeeciddooda anigoo ka mamnuucaya inay cabbaan wax ka badan hal qaado oo biyo ah.
Iyadoo ay yar yihiin tirada kuwa adkaystay ka dib imtixaanka, waxaan la kulanay dagaalyahan xooggan iyo ciidankooda.
Aniga oo hoos jooga, qof dhallinyaro ah oo ka tirsan ciidankayga, oo aan ahayn dagaalyahan caan ah, ayaa si geesinimo leh ula dagaallamay oo uga adkaaday halyeeyga cadowga ee xoogga badan.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Magacaabista hoggaamiye ka dhan ah nin weyn
trial.answer: Magacaabista hoggaamiye ka dhan ah nin weyn

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Boqortooyo ayaa la aasaasay oo leh hanti iyo awood aad u badan.
Dadkii waxaa ku qaraqmay daad weyn.
Horyaalkii cadowga waa la jabiyay, Alle ayaana guusha siiyay.
Abaar weyn ayaa dhulka ku dhufatay sannado badan.
outcome.answer: Horyaalkii cadowga waa la jabiyay, Alle ayaana guusha siiyay.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
